summary: Complete independent final canonical date audit after curation. All 122 Chinese source units, 134 temporal or active-hint items, and 44 people were checked against the current extraction. The seven prior repair groups remain correctly resolved: dated enshrinements, titles, and honors of deceased people are posthumous commemoration rather than life evidence; their false attestations and active hints are absent; and An Chonghui’s Mingzong 在藩 context is conservatively bounded on or before AD 926. Regnal dates retain year precision only, no unresolved chronology or source-ownership error remains.
